_meta.leaf_format: P = {value, low, high, provenance, source, note}
_meta.caveat: Primary utility/government hosts were blocked from the build environment; most web facts are search-result extracts. Re-verify before relying on them.

electricity_usd_per_kwh.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.A Michigan residential: 21.20 c/kWh (Mar 2026), 22.99 c/kWh (Aug 2026), 2026 YTD avg 21.73 c (via electricity-cost.pages.dev and greencalculus.com citing EIA, extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20); DTE cross-check: MPSC-approved DTE Electric increase 'typical residential customer using 500 kWh per month will see an increase of $4.93, or 4.6%' -> implied bill ~$112/500 kWh = $0.224/kWh all-in incl. customer charge (extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment))
electricity_usd_per_kwh.note: All-in average incl. delivery, PSCR and the ~$8.50/mo customer charge spread over usage. DTE D1 tariff sheet (MPSC rate book) not retrieved. Low/high cover summer-peak vs off-peak and month-to-month variation.

gas_usd_per_therm.source: MPSC news release 2026-09-10 'MPSC approves DTE Gas Co. infrastructure investments' (michigan.gov/mpsc): typical residential customer using 75 ccf/month bill rises by $2.87, or 3.34% -> implied bill $88.80/75 ccf = $1.18/ccf = ~$1.14/therm (1 ccf ~ 1.037 therm) incl. customer charge; GCR ~$0.39/ccf (Jan 2026, utilitiesformyhome.com) and MPSC max GCR $3.84/Mcf (12 mo to 2026-03-31). extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20
gas_usd_per_therm.note: Marginal cost per extra therm is lower (~$0.85-0.95) because the fixed customer charge is in the all-in figure; high band covers GCR spikes such as January 2026 and the 68-cent/mo IRM charge from Jan 1.

monthly_hdd_source.source: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020, station USC00200230 (ANN ARBOR UNIV OF MICH), monthly MLY-HTDD-NORMAL / MLY-CLDD-NORMAL (base 65F); file data/raw/noaa_normals/USC00200230_monthly_1991-2020.csv (from NOAA open-data S3 bucket)
monthly_hdd_source.note: value = annual sum; monthly values in monthly_hdd

house_pre1950.source: EIA RECS 2020 via EIA Today in Energy #57321 (eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=57321), extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20; floor areas and regional HDD assumed (see README)
house_pre1950.note: 748 therms/(6200 HDD x 1.75 ksf) = 0.0689; band widened for drafty student rentals (upper) and weatherized units (lower)

house_1950_1990.source: EIA RECS 2020 via EIA Today in Energy #57321 (eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=57321), extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20; floor areas and regional HDD assumed (see README)
house_1950_1990.note: ~Michigan all-home average 727 therms/(6500 HDD x 1.9 ksf) = 0.0589

house_post1990.source: EIA RECS 2020 via EIA Today in Energy #57321 (eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=57321), extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20; floor areas and regional HDD assumed (see README)
house_post1990.note: post-2010 Midwest 489 therms/(6200 x 2.3 ksf) = 0.0343; 1990-2009 stock assumed between this and the 1950-1990 value

apartment.source: EIA RECS 2020 via EIA Today in Energy #57321 (eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=57321), extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20; floor areas and regional HDD assumed (see README)
apartment.note: shared walls/floors: assumed ~40% below 1950-1990 detached intensity

tower.source: EIA RECS 2020 via EIA Today in Energy #57321 (eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=57321), extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20; floor areas and regional HDD assumed (see README)
tower.note: modern high-rise envelope, interior units; many towers heat electrically -> convert with 29.3 kWh/therm x furnace efficiency ratio (0.8 gas AFUE vs 1.0 resistance, ~2.5 COP heat pump)

duplex.source: EIA RECS 2020 via EIA Today in Energy #57321 (eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=57321), extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20; floor areas and regional HDD assumed (see README)
duplex.note: one shared wall; typically pre-1960 Ann Arbor stock

coop.source: EIA RECS 2020 via EIA Today in Energy #57321 (eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=57321), extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20; floor areas and regional HDD assumed (see README)
coop.note: large pre-1940 houses; ICC charges include utilities so this rarely reaches a member's ledger

base_kwh_per_person_month.source: Team assumption anchored to EIA RECS 2020 Midwest household electricity use for lighting/appliances/electronics (not retrieved this session); students in shared units share fridge/range
base_kwh_per_person_month.note: Excludes electric space heating/cooling (model those from HDD/CDD). Add ~0.8 kWh per CDD per 1000 sqft for window/central AC (assumed).

internet_usd_unit_month.source: Ann Arbor plan prices via broadbandnow.com / internetproviders.ai / reviews.org: AT&T Fiber 300 Mbps ~$35-40/mo, Xfinity base tiers ~$30-40/mo promotional (extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20)
internet_usd_unit_month.note: Value assumes post-promotional price plus equipment/taxes; low = promo price.

water_sewer_trash_usd_person_month.source: City of Ann Arbor FY27 rate schedule (a2gov.org/media/usphkox3/water-rates-fy27.pdf, effective 2026-07-01): water customer charge $36.26/quarter and sewer customer charge $17.94/quarter for a 3/4-inch meter; stormwater billed separately (tier 1 $39.17/quarter per city stormwater page) (extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20); WEMU 2025-04-21/2026-04-06 on rate increases
water_sewer_trash_usd_person_month.note: Per-person = fixed charges (~$31/mo/household incl. stormwater) / 3 persons + volumetric water+sewer for ~2 ccf/person-month at an ASSUMED ~$11/ccf combined (FY27 volumetric rates not retrieved). Curbside trash is not separately billed to Ann Arbor residents (assumed: city solid-waste millage) -> $0. Usually landlord-paid in apartments/towers.

renters_insurance_usd_month.source: insure.com 'average renters insurance cost in Ann Arbor, MI' (~$13/mo), lainsurance.com (~$24/mo MI), Michigan guides $15-30/mo (extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20)
renters_insurance_usd_month.note: Per person; standard $20-30k personal property policy. Often lease-required in towers.

um_parking_permit_usd_year.source: U-M Logistics, Transportation & Parking, 'New campus parking permit rates effective July 1, 2026' (ltp.umich.edu/2026/04/29/...) and permit pages: FY27 Student Yellow $188/yr; Student Orange $96/yr (juniors/seniors/grad; North, Ross Athletic, West Side Orange lots); Student Yellow w/After Hours $268 (July 1-14 price) (extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20)
um_parking_permit_usd_year.note: Campus permit only; does NOT include parking at home (see Listing.parking_monthly). Orange prices decline through the year.

bus_fare_student.source: U-M LTP rider guide (ltp.umich.edu/campus-transit/rider-guide): Blue Bus free, no ID needed; LTP MRide page and TheRide: active U-M students ride TheRide fixed routes free with a valid MCard ('U-M pays fares for U-M riders') (extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment), accessed 2026-11-20)
bus_fare_student.note: MCard not accepted on TheRide FootballRide. No 2026 policy change found.

default_sqft_per_bedroom.source: Median of observed listings with stated sqft and >=2 bedrooms in data/listings/listings.json (Six11 4BR 1209 sqft, Landmark 2BR 1095, Varsity 2BR 750, Arbor Blu 2BR 741, 1313 S State 2BR 800, Huron Towers 2BR 742, 1323 Cambridge 6BR 2645)
default_sqft_per_bedroom.note: Includes the bedroom's share of common space. Used only when Listing.sqft is null.

security_deposit_max_months.source: Michigan Security Deposit Act, MCL 554.602 (max 1.5 months' rent); UM Off-Campus Housing deposit page offcampus.umich.edu/node/2728 (via research/ann-arbor-market.md A4, extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment))
security_deposit_max_months.note: Prepaid rent beyond the first month counts toward the cap (UM OCH).

application_fee_cap_usd.source: Ann Arbor City Code 8:532 (effective 2025-01-26): application fees capped at $50, refundable within 60 days if no unit offered; pre-tenancy (waitlist/holding/option) fees banned. Via research/ann-arbor-market.md A3 (extract-only (search-result text; page not fetched from this environment); a2gov.org blocked)
